jobs.occupation: AWS Cloud Architect at Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
Do you want to design cloud solutions that dozens of teams reuse, instead of building for just one?

Our mission is to enable our DevOps teams to focus on building great applications by providing a shared internal developer platform, tools, templates and ways of working that simplify the entire software development lifecycle. Today, we support more than 20 teams across all three divisions, combining hands-on engineering with coaching, training and technical enablement.

Ultimately, our goal is simple: remove complexity, create great developer experiences and enable teams to deliver secure, high-quality software faster.

Role Description
As a Cloud Architect in CORE Platform, you will help shape the AWS foundation that our DevOps teams build on. Instead of every team solving the same cloud challenges themselves, we create reusable patterns, guardrails and infrastructure-as-code that make it easier to build, deploy and operate software securely and efficiently.

You will combine hands-on cloud engineering with architecture and enablement, designing and operating shared AWS capabilities while working closely with the teams that use them. Their challenges and feedback become input for better automation, self-service and reusable solutions across the organization.

Together with colleagues across Platform Engineering, Product and Security, you will help develop a coherent platform where reliability and security are built in from the start. You will also run Game Days, including sessions together with AWS, and use those learnings to continuously strengthen the platform.

Looking ahead, we are preparing for AI agents to become platform users alongside developers. You will have the opportunity to help shape the cloud patterns and secure environments that make that possible, while influencing how Husqvarna’s use of AWS evolves. What you will do:
Design and build reusable AWS patterns, templates and guardrails as code.
Ensure our cloud capabilities are reliable, secure and performant.
Improve automation and self-service based on the needs of our DevOps teams.
Run Game Days and turn learnings into concrete improvements.
Evolve our cloud patterns as AWS, technology and user needs change.
Coach and mentor engineers across teams.

Your profile
Beyond your technical expertise, you have a customer-focused mindset and genuinely care about creating solutions that teams find useful and want to adopt. You are curious, pragmatic and comfortable exploring new technologies and unfamiliar challenges. As a senior colleague, you enjoy sharing your knowledge, coaching others and helping people grow.

You are also curious about how AI is changing software development, while taking a balanced and practical view of where it creates real value. Most importantly, you are a collaborative and humble team player who brings a positive attitude, a sense of humour and a willingness to succeed together. You have:
 
5+ years of professional experience working with cloud technologies, with deep knowledge of AWS.
Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code and designing and running containerized applications in AWS.
Experience building highly available, reliable cloud solutions and the ability to explain the trade-offs behind your architectural decisions.
Experience with container services such as ECS and/or Kubernetes platforms such as EKS.
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Experience with AWS CDK is a plus.

Location
Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application
Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For more questions regarding the position please contact: Hiring Manager: Mathias von Knorring, mathias.von.knorring@husqvarnagroup.com.  For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture 
We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.
 
Our culture is built on three core themes: 
Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. 

 
Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

We are looking for one to two professors of Statistics for permanent positions at the School of Business.
Subject area
The subject area for this position is Statistics.
Background
Örebro University is seeking one to two professors of Statistics to strengthen and expand our research. Research in the Department of Statistics is mainly focused on Bayesian Statistics with applications in Economics and Finance, as well as Survey Methodology. Formally, and based on a close collaboration, the Departments of Statistics and Economics constitutes a joint research environment with cross-disciplinary research groups in wellbeing and health economics; entrepreneurship, globalization and institutions; macro- and financial econometrics (MAFE) and statistics (stat@oru). In addition, the department benefits from a close collaboration with Statistics Sweden. We are looking for candidates whose expertise can, in particular, strengthen the MAFE and stat@oru groups, and who can also take on a leadership role.
Education in the Department of Statistics spans the bachelor’s, master’s and doctoral levels. In addition to the Bachelor’s Programme in Statistics, courses are offered in, among others, the Programme for Business and Economics. At the master’s level, a two-year study programme in statistics is offered which has been awarded the ‘European Master in Official Statistics’ (EMOS) label by Eurostat. The department also offers courses in the Master’s Programme in Economics and Econometrics, and the Master’s Programme in Finance.
In addition to Statistics and Economics, Örebro University School of Business hosts the departments of Business Administration and Informatics. The Business School is accredited by AACSB, the largest accreditation body and network for business schools globally – an achievement accomplished only by five per cent of the world’s 16,000 business schools.
Duties and responsibilities
As a rule, a professor at Örebro University spends the bulk of their working hours on research. They are also expected to work actively to bring in external research grants to the subject, take overall responsibility for its research activities, and monitor developments within the subject field internationally. A professor is expected to be involved at all three levels of higher education and to communicate and collaborate around their own and the department’s research activities.
A professor is moreover expected, within the scope of their employment, to make themselves available for executive and administrative assignments at the university.
The professorships are aimed at strengthening the research in Statistics. We particularly welcome candidates whose research focuses on Bayesian Statistics, Econometrics, Time Series Analysis and/or Survey Statistics. We are seeking individuals with the vision and potential to drive the development in the subject. As two professors are being recruited, the aim is for the appointments to have complementary research profiles and, taken together, to strengthen the breadth of Statistics at Örebro University across the areas listed above.
Qualifications and assessment criteria

Software Test Solutions develops our in-house test framework, which is used to test our products, and plays a critical role in ensuring product quality and reliability. Many teams rely on the accuracy of our test results, which makes our work essential for validating our products against their specifications.
We are looking for a software developer who thrives in an agile environment and wants to be part of a team that builds and maintains this framework and its tools. The framework is used for system-level testing of our products in network solutions, running on dedicated test systems.
Our department is made up of two teams: the Test Framework team (the role described here), which schedules and runs tests, processes the test results and maintains the test systems, and the Test Developer team, which develops and maintains tests for our operating system WeOS. We promote close collaboration between the two teams, so your work won't necessarily stay limited to the framework – there's plenty of room to explore and contribute across both.
In your role, you will be:

Programming primarily in Python (and Go), working with tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.

Analysing test results and troubleshooting and refining the framework to keep it reliable.

Maintaining and developing the test systems, with the devices under test, that the framework relies on.

Extending the framework to support new WeOS functionality.

Developing the next generation of our test framework to meet future demands on scalability, including virtual testing, and reduced complexity for end users.

Working with both front-end and back-end development of the web interfaces for configuration and visualization of test results.

We think about automation in everything we do, and we are always trying out new technologies that help us meet current and future demands. We use Jira for planning and tracking work, and keep improving our Agile methods. AI is also a natural part of our daily software work, and we are exploring how to put it to even better use.

You have an academic background in computer science or similar, and you’re motivated by solving real problems with smart solutions. We value teamwork, and hope you do, too. You enjoy both technical development and team collaboration, and you share your knowledge just as readily as you ask for help. You are curious and innovative, comfortable in an agile environment, and like to try, test, and learn with colleagues.
Further, we want you to be:

Experienced in Python development and eager to deepen your skills.

Comfortable working in a Linux environment.

Familiar with software engineering tools such as source code management, CI/CD, containers, and web development (front-end and/or back-end).

Interested in networking technologies.

Fluent in English and Swedish.

Oh, and don't worry, if you're not an expert in all the things described – you'll learn.
In return, we offer: You will be working at the forefront of technology in a friendly, open culture where you get the opportunity to learn from skilled colleagues every day. A mature and caring leadership in a flat organization. Through our collective bargain agreement you will be covered in terms of insurance, pension and other benefits. We like to have fun together and we regularly enjoy sports and other social activities as a team. We believe that magic happens when people meet. We are a learning organization and we truly love to try new things, think outside the box and be innovative together!

Systems of systems integration
Combat system to ship integration
Architecture and requirements
Cyber security
Acceptance & verification
Commissioning

Contribute actively to the engineering management team, including strategic planning, resource balancing and competence development.

This change is driven by our current situation: many ongoing projects, high demand, and significant resource constraints. We are convinced that greater reuse, clearer ownership of processes and more structured onboarding will be key to securing our long-term capacity and competitiveness.

As a person, you are clear, trustworthy and engaging. You create participation, set direction and dare to challenge established ways of working - always with the business, the customer and your people in focus.

Solid experience from systems development in a complex, regulated or safety-critical environment.
Proven leadership experience, preferably with responsibility for managers and senior experts.
Experience of driving change and improvement work in engineering organizations, for example within verification & acceptance, commissioning
An understanding for or experience with running large and complex projects.
A structured and analytical working style, with the ability to see the big picture and at the same time understand operational challenges.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in English, both spoken and written. Knowledge of Swedish, Finnish or German is an advantage but not a requirement.

jobs.occupation: Academic Advisor to the Stockholm School of Economics
jobs.description:
The Education Office (EdO) is one of SSE’s Professional Services units and consists of around 58 colleagues. As a central part of the SSE journey, we support and develop key academic services for students and stakeholders across our BSc, MSc, and PhD programs. Our work spans assessment, program management, scholarships, international collaborations, academic support, central course and exam coordination, as well as degrees and certificates.
We are looking for an Academic Advisor to join our Guidance and Wellbeing Office (GWO). As an Academic Advisor at SSE, you will work closely with students across our Bachelor and Master programs, providing guidance and support throughout their studies. 
The GWO team consists of two Academic Advisors and one Student Wellbeing Counsellor. Together, the team provides a first point of contact for students who need support related to their studies, their individual educational needs, or challenges that may affect their ability to study. The team also coordinates support for students with specific educational needs. 
As an Academic Advisor, you will: 
Provide individual guidance to students on study-related matters, helping them navigate challenges and make informed decisions about their studies. 
Meet students with a wide range of needs and circumstances and help identify appropriate forms of support. 
Coordinate support for students with specific educational needs and work with relevant colleagues to ensure appropriate arrangements. 
Work closely with the Student Wellbeing Counsellor and the other Academic Advisor to provide coordinated support to students. 
Guide students to other relevant functions or professional support when their needs fall outside the scope of academic advising. 
Collaborate with faculty and other colleagues across SSE on student-related matters. 
Contribute to developing routines, information and ways of working within GWO 
Participate in preventive and student-focused initiatives aimed at creating good conditions for students to succeed in their studies. 

What we offer you
At SSE, you’ll join a small, close-knit GWO team and work across a lively academic community. The role combines one-to-one work with students and collaboration with faculty and colleagues throughout the School. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how GWO supports students, develop its ways of working and contribute to initiatives that strengthen the study experience. It’s a varied role with room to take initiative, build strong working relationships and be part of students’ academic journeys.
About you
You are an attentive, confident communicator who can build trust while maintaining clear professional boundaries. You are comfortable meeting students with varied needs, including in challenging or sensitive situations.
You listen with care, ask thoughtful questions and can work out what kind of guidance or support may be most useful. You are calm and practical when situations are complex, and you enjoy working closely with colleagues who bring different areas of expertise. You are also ready to contribute to initiatives that strengthen students’ wellbeing and study experience.
Qualifications
We are looking for someone with:

A Bachelor’s degree in Study and Career Guidance (Swedish: Studie- och yrkesvägledarexamen).

Experience in student support, academic advising, counselling, education or another role involving professional guidance and individual support.

Spoken and written Swedish and English.

Meritorious

Knowledge of educational support for students with disabilities or other specific educational needs.

Experience using Nais and Ladok.

Experience working in higher education.

Other:
This is a full-time, permanent position with an initial six-month probationary period. The position is based in Stockholm and start date is according to agreement.
We encourage you to apply promptly as we are actively reviewing applications on an ongoing basis. 
We look forward to receiving your application.
About the Stockholm School of Economics
The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.
Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.
SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.
SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

Looking for the next step in your payroll career within a global organization? 
Our colleague is retiring, and we are now looking for a new team member to join our payroll team in Karlstad. This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a global organization where people are at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you will take ownership of complex payroll processes, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, and play a key role in delivering payroll services and an excellent employee experience. Expectations for you

You have excellent analytical skills, strong attention to detail, and a structured approach to your work. 
You communicate fluently in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.  

Payroll certification is considered a merit. 
To succeed in this role 
Success in this role requires solid payroll expertise, a thorough understanding of payroll legislation, and the ability to manage complex payroll processes with a high degree of accuracy. You are proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders. You stay up to date with changes in regulations and continuously look for ways to improve processes and service quality. 
We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles - practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together: 
Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through 
Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly 
Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety 
Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value 

We offer 
You will join a dedicated payroll team responsible for delivering high-quality payroll and time management services while ensuring compliance and a positive employee experience. The team plays an important role in supporting employees and managers, driving process improvements, and maintaining efficient payroll operations across multiple countries.
Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with excellent opportunities for professional growth and development. We value our employees and provide a comprehensive benefits package, including wellness benefits, healthcare insurance, wellbeing initiatives, and learning opportunities. We encourage internal mobility and support continuous competence development to help our people grow throughout their careers. 
Want to know more? 
For further information about the position, please contact Ulrika Lindegren, Payroll Manager, Northern Europe at ulrika.lindegren@valmet.com. Please note that applications cannot be accepted via email and must be submitted through our careers site.
If you are interested in becoming part of the team, you can apply by December 1. We review applications continuously and may fill the position before the application deadline, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace. 
When everything works together 
Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 18,500 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views. 
Join the team – and lead the way with us!

Job Description
Business Development & Delivery (BD&D) sits within the H&M Group Strategy function and acts as the bridge between strategic intent and execution, ensuring that our company not only sets ambitious goals but achieves them efficiently through well-defined business development plans, strong processes and a win-win collaboration approach. The team in BD&D works with: 
Translating our strategy to business development plans; 
Lead and manage cross-functional business development programs 
Manage the H&M Group development portfolio (programs, projects, CI); 
Targeted strategic project support to solve company challenges with high functional interdependencies and complex scope 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 
The Project Manager is a key role within the targeted strategic project support scope of the BD&D team. As we continue executing on an ambitious Business Development agenda, we need strong strategic project leadership competencies to accelerate and enable critical parts of our functional scope, translating strategy into execution and solving complex operational problems at pace. 
At its core, this role is about bridging the gap between where we want to go and how we get there. You will lead projects that enable our Business Development agenda to succeed, embed yourself into critical programs and functions, and act as a trusted partner to senior leadership. In doing so, you will build a deep understanding of H&M Group's business and gain a strong platform for continued growth within the company. 
Key responsibilities include: 
Initiative Definition & Strategic Translation 
Translate high-level strategic goals into concrete, structured Business Development initiatives that can be embedded within functions and delivered cross-functionally. 

High-Impact Project Leadership 
Lead targeted, high-impact projects within the BD&D agenda; within a single function or across multiple from problem definition through to delivery. 
Structure the approach from the ground up: identifying the right stakeholders, defining the problem, building the plan, and driving execution. 
Proactively identify risks and blockers, push for resolution, and report back to BD&D leadership with clear updates and recommendations. 

Program acceleration 
Embed directly into our critical cross-functional programs as a strategic project lead, driving momentum and ensuring delivery stays on track. 
Lead and facilitate workshops, set and manage scope, define goals and milestones, and own stakeholder alignment across functions and leadership levels. 
Act as the connective role between program workstreams, identifying risks and blockers early and pushing for resolution. 

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH 
 
You will join a team of skilled Project Managers, working at the intersection of strategic direction and hands-on delivery. This is a role for someone who thrives on turning ambiguity into structured action, driving alignment across complex organizations, and making things happen in cross-functional environments. 
WHO YOU ARE 
Success in this role requires exceptional stakeholder management and facilitation skills, the ability to structure and solve complex problems, and a talent for shaping clear, compelling messages out of abstract and nuanced material. You combine strategic thinking with strong analytical capability and a proactive mindset, taking ownership of initiatives and driving them from concept to high‑quality outcomes. 
You will work closely with senior leadership and cross‑functional teams to drive prioritisation, governance and effective decision‑making, ensuring strategic goals translate into tangible results. Comfortable operating across levels, you understand differing perspectives and influence with clarity and credibility – confidently challenging senior stakeholders when needed. You thrive in an environment characterised by change and complexity and adapt your approach to create alignment and momentum. 
To succeed in this role, you also have: 
~2-4 years of experience from a top-tier strategy consulting firm with a strong track record of delivering in fast-paced, high-stakes environments. 
Strong analytical capability, comfortable working with both quantitative and qualitative data to build a compelling case or recommendation. 
Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously without dropping the ball. 
High proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word as well as AI tools such as Claude and Copilot - able to produce senior-ready output independently and at pace. 

WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here. 
 
JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. 
This is a permanent position based in Stockholm. You will formally report to the Head of Business Development & Delivery, with day-to-day leadership, coaching, and feedback provided by the Project Management Team Lead. 
 
Please send your CV in English as soon as possible. (For internal candidates, please initiate a dialogue with you manager before applying). 
*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Silex Microsystems is the world’s leading pure-play MEMS foundry, partnering with global clients to develop some of the most advanced MEMS products in the world.
As a Senior Product Manager in our Product Development team, you will play a key role in pushing the boundaries of what is technically possible — working hands-on with cutting-edge processes while driving complex development projects forward. This is a highly technical, project-driven role where you combine microfabrication expertise with strong project management to take products from concept to market. You will bring the experience to independently lead complex projects, guide technical decisions, and manage customer dialogue.
Read more about Silex here.
The Team
You will join our Product Development team of around 40 colleagues, including Product Managers, Process Design Engineers and CAD Engineers, and you’ll be reporting to a Group Manager.
The team works at the core of Silex’s offering — translating customer designs into manufacturable MEMS products. Collaboration is key, and you will work closely with both internal experts and international customers in a highly knowledge-driven environment.
The role
In this role, you will independently lead the development of complex MEMS products from early concept through prototype, combining technical depth with structured project management.
Customers typically come to Silex with a design concept, and together with our CAD Engineers and technical experts, you will evaluate and shape that design to ensure it is manufacturable. Early in the process, you will bring together specialists from different process areas to define a robust concept and create a scalable process flow, and a recipe for the new product. In this concept phase, you will be ensuring that all critical aspects are considered before the customer approves the concept, and the project moves into prototyping. You will use your experience to evaluate technical trade-offs and guide decisions on feasibility, process choices, and project risks.
As the project progresses into the prototype phase, you will own the overall execution — ensuring timelines are met, risks are managed, and technical challenges are solved along the way.
A part of the role is hands-on work in the cleanroom. After each process step, you will evaluate the outcome using tools such as SEM analysis to determine whether the desired result has been achieved. Based on your findings, you will work closely with Process Engineers to tweak parameters in processes to achieve the desired result. Finally, you’re responsible for the delivery of the final prototype to the client.
You’ll receive an introduction to Silex’s development process and tools, tailored to your experience. As you become familiar with our ways of working, you will take ownership of the technical customer interface, leading discussions around progress, challenges, technical trade-offs, and next steps.
In this role, you will

Independently drive complex MEMS development projects from concept to the delivery of a final prototype.

Evaluate customer designs and ensure manufacturability together with CAD and process experts.

Define process flows and build fabrication recipes for new products.

Bring together cross-functional experts early in the project to ensure a robust concept.

Analyze process results using SEM and other characterization methods.

Collaborate with Process Engineers to achieve desired results after each fabrication step.

Own project timelines, order portfolios, progress, and delivery.

Identify risks, troubleshoot issues, and ensure forward momentum.

Act as the technical lead towards customers.

Lead technical discussions, reporting, and planning.

What We’re Looking For

A Master’s degree or PhD with coursework in microfabrication/ nanotechnology.

Extensive hands-on experience with microfabrication in an industrial environment, ideally using processes like lithography, plasma deposition and plasma etching.

Strong communication skills and the ability to discuss technical topics in English. Swedish is considered highly beneficial as a lot of internal documentation is written in Swedish.

Previous experience with customer interaction, including independently leading technical discussions and managing customer expectations.

Several years of industry experience in production environments, leading complex technical projects, with responsibility for planning, risk management, and delivery.

To succeed in the role, we also think that you are

A clear and adaptable communicator, able to engage both colleagues and customers.

Organized and methodical in how you drive projects forward.

Curious and eager to deepen your expertise in MEMS.

Business-minded and focused on delivering value to customers.

About the recruitment process
We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV, and answer a few questions.
If you progress through the full process, you will start with a digital interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners, followed by a personality and logical ability test. Next, you will meet with one of our Group Managers together with a Talent Acquisition Partner for an in-person interview, and finally with our VP of Product Development for a concluding interview. Before an offer, we also conduct reference checks, a background check, and a drug test. Randomized alcohol- and drug testing is conducted for all of our employees during the employment.

Mine Technical Service Aitik
Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come. 
Your opportunity
Help shape safe, predictable and cost-effective blasting at one of Sweden’s major open-pit mining operations. You will convert mine plans and field conditions into practical drill and blast designs, support execution in the pit, and use performance data to improve fragmentation, wall control, ore recovery and production flow.
Who you will work with
Mine Technical Service in Aitik includes specialist teams in geology, mine surveying, mine planning, drill and blast technology, geotechnics and geohydrology. We work closely with operations and other departments to create conditions for safe and efficient production
What you will do
As a Drill and Blast Specialist, you will be part of the team responsible for planning, preparing, following up and improving drilling and blasting activities. The role combines technical design and planning work with regular field presence. 
You will prepare practical drill and blast plans, support safe implementation in the field, follow up results and help improve the way we work. The role suits someone who understands mining operations, enjoys practical problem-solving and is interested in developing further within drill and blast.
Key responsibilities are:
·      Develop drill patterns, charging plans, initiation sequences and blast documentation for production, trim and wall-control blasting.
·      Prepare short-term drill and blast plans and schedules aligned with the approved mine plan, production priorities and geotechnical requirements.
·      Provide field support before, during and after blasting, including design mark-up, drill-hole and charging QA/QC, tie-in verification and blast-area risk controls.
·      Monitor drilling accuracy, hole condition, explosive loading and compliance with approved designs and standards.
·      Conduct post-blast inspections and reconcile planned versus actual results, including fragmentation, floor condition, toes, backbreak, dilution, ore loss, vibration and dig performance.
·      Maintain accurate blast records, charging sheets, design files, KPI data and reports, including powder factor, drill productivity, explosive consumption and blast performance.
·      Collaborate with geology, survey, mine planning, geotechnical and production teams to support ore recovery, stable pit walls and efficient loading, hauling and crushing.
·      Support investigations and corrective actions relating to drill and blast deviations, misfires, flyrock, excessive vibration or other blasting risks.
·      Coordinate technical matters with drilling contractors, explosives suppliers and technology providers, and contribute to trials and continuous-improvement projects.
What you bring
If you have experience of mining or a related operational environment and are interested in drill and blast, we encourage you to apply. We value practical site knowledge, a strong safety mindset and the motivation to develop within the role. Practical experience from drilling, blasting, charging, explosives or production work is highly valued, while technical qualifications or an engineering degree are considered an advantage. Knowledge can have been gained through hands-on work, vocational education, workplace training or university studies.
Experience and knowledge
·      Experience in drilling, blasting, charging or production work is especially relevant. 
·      Relevant technical education is beneficial but not required. 
·      Experience with drill and blast software is an advantage, but training can be provided
·      Knowledge of safe blasting practices is beneficial.
 Skills and personal qualities
·      Strong commitment to safety. 
·      Structured and responsible way of working. 
·      Practical problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn. 
·      Good communication and collaboration skills. 
·      Valid Category B driving license. 
·      English language skills are required; Swedish is an advantage.
We value potential and encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement.
Why work with us
At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
As a Lead Engineer within Siemens Energy’s Modifications & Upgrades organization, you will play a key role in delivering modernization and upgrading projects for our global fleet of gas and steam turbines.
You will be responsible for the technical coordination of the electrical and control system scope throughout the project lifecycle, from sales support and engineering to commissioning and customer handover. Working closely with project managers, customers, suppliers, commissioning teams, and engineering specialists, you will ensure that the technical solution is clearly defined, coordinated, and successfully executed.
The role combines technical leadership, project execution, problem-solving, and customer interaction in an international environment. You will join a highly skilled and supportive team working with complex technical challenges, modern control systems, digitalization, and lifetime extension solutions for our installed fleet.

Lead and coordinate the electrical and control system scope in modernization and upgrading projects.
Develop a clear technical execution plan, define deliverables and interfaces, and drive activities from planning through commissioning.
Act as a key technical interface towards customers, project management, suppliers, commissioning teams, and internal engineering functions.
Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities and ensure alignment between technical disciplines and project requirements.
Identify and manage technical risks, changed conditions, and complex engineering challenges throughout project execution.
Lead technical discussions and contribute to solutions that improve plant performance, reliability, availability, and sustainability.
Support modernization initiatives such as control system upgrades, system migrations, obsolescence management, digital solutions, and performance improvements.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to represent the technical scope in customer and project meetings.
A solution-oriented, responsible, flexible, and organized approach, combined with a strong desire to learn and develop.
A collaborative leadership style and an interest in enabling and supporting colleagues across functions and cultures.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

You will be part of Siemens Energy’s Modifications & Upgrades organization, which delivers modernization, upgrade, and lifetime extension solutions for the installed fleet of gas and steam turbines.

jobs.occupation: Registered nurses wanted for permanent positions in Agder, Southern Norway
jobs.description:
Are you a qualified nurse looking for a permanent position in Norway, with the opportunity to work in a nursing home or home care services?
On behalf of a municipality in Agder, Southern Norway, we are recruiting registered nurses for permanent positions within municipal healthcare services. These roles offer varied clinical responsibilities, independent nursing practice and close collaboration with other healthcare professionals.
You will work with patients who have different medical and care needs, contributing to safe, high-quality healthcare in a supportive professional environment.
The municipality is located approximately 30 minutes from the coastal town of Risør, surrounded by forests, lakes and beautiful countryside. Here, you can combine a rewarding nursing career with a quieter lifestyle and easy access to Norway’s southern coastline.
About the positions
The municipality provides a range of healthcare and care services, including nursing home care, short-term care, dementia care and home-based nursing services.
In the nursing home, you will care for patients who require round-the-clock nursing, treatment and medical follow-up. Your responsibilities may include general nursing care, dementia care and supporting patients with complex or long-term health conditions. The nursing home has long-term care units, short-term care beds and a dedicated unit for people living with dementia.
In home care services, you will provide nursing care and follow-up to patients living in their own homes or supported housing. You will carry out independent nursing assessments, provide medical treatment and help patients maintain their independence and quality of life.
In both settings, nurses work closely with healthcare assistants, doctors and other healthcare professionals to ensure safe and coordinated patient care.
Responsibilities
Your responsibilities may include:
Assessing, monitoring and evaluating patients’ health conditions
Administering medication and performing clinical procedures
Providing nursing care, treatment and follow-up for patients with acute and chronic conditions
Caring for elderly patients and people with dementia or complex healthcare needs
Collaborating with doctors, healthcare assistants and other healthcare professionals
Providing guidance and support to patients, relatives and colleagues
Maintaining accurate documentation in electronic patient record systems
Contributing to quality improvement and the development of healthcare services

Specific responsibilities will vary depending on the department and service. Further information about the workplace, duties, working hours and shift arrangements will be provided during the recruitment process.
Qualifications
EU/EEA citizenship and a valid nursing qualification and licence from an EU/EEA country
Norwegian nursing authorisation is required before starting work. We will guide you through the application process
Good English communication skills and motivation to learn Norwegian. Norwegian language training is provided
Good communication and teamwork skills
Ability to make independent nursing assessments and take clinical responsibility
Experience in nursing homes, elderly care or home care services is an advantage
A category B driving licence may be required, depending on the workplace
A satisfactory police certificate is required before starting work, in accordance with Norwegian regulations.

Who we are looking for
We are looking for dedicated and compassionate nurses who are confident in their clinical skills and comfortable taking responsibility for patient care.
You should enjoy working with patients who have different healthcare needs, communicate well with colleagues and contribute to a positive working environment.
We are particularly interested in candidates who are motivated to build a long-term nursing career in Norway and are open to relocating and settling in the municipality.
What we offer
Permanent nursing positions in nursing homes and home care services
Varied and meaningful clinical responsibilities
Collaboration with experienced healthcare professionals and opportunities for professional development
Salary and employment conditions to be agreed upon
Guidance through the Norwegian nursing authorisation process
Free online Norwegian language training with a dedicated private tutor.
Personal support from Dignus Medical throughout the recruitment process
Assistance with relocation and settling in Norway

Live and work in Southern Norway
Imagine living surrounded by forests and lakes, with plenty of space to enjoy the outdoors and Norway’s beautiful southern coastline just a short drive away.
The municipality is located in eastern Agder, approximately 30 minutes from Risør, a charming coastal town known for its traditional wooden houses, harbour and maritime atmosphere.
The surrounding area offers swimming spots, hiking trails, fishing lakes and forests where you can pick berries and mushrooms. During the summer, you can explore the archipelago, enjoy the cafés and restaurants along the waterfront in Risør or spend a day at one of the many beaches along the southern coast.
For those considering relocating with their families, the municipality offers kindergartens, schools and recreational activities for children. There is also a local shopping area with shops, restaurants and essential services.
Here, you can enjoy a peaceful countryside lifestyle while still having convenient access to coastal towns, everyday amenities and outdoor activities throughout the year.
Interested?
Contact us to learn more about the positions, the workplace and the recruitment process.
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Product Manager MEKO Denmark  – Heavy Commercial Vehicles
jobs.description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

Do you have a strong background in heavy commercial vehicles, spare parts or technical aftermarket operations? Are you interested in developing your career within product management while working in an international organization?
This could be an opportunity to take the next step.

MEKO is looking for a Product Manager to support the continued expansion of its Commercial Vehicle Division under its FTZ brand in Denmark.

You will contribute to the development of product groups within trucks, trailers and buses, combining your technical industry knowledge with practical product management and commercial coordination.

We welcome candidates from both Denmark and Southern Sweden. Previous experience as a Product Manager is valuable but not essential. What matters most is your understanding of commercial vehicles and the motivation to develop within a growing business.

Your responsibilities

As Product Manager, you will be part of MEKO's Commercial Vehicle Division and work closely with the Danish FTZ Truck & Trailer organization.

You will support the development of several product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles, helping ensure the right assortment, pricing and product information are available to meet customer needs and commercial objectives.

Your responsibilities will include:

•	Identifying and supporting new product launches and assortment development initiatives.
•	Preparing sourcing requirements and request-for-quotation material, as well as evaluating products together with colleagues in other MEKO markets.
•	Coordinating product introductions, replacements and phase-outs.
•	Managing product data and maintaining information in catalogues and PIM systems.
•	Monitoring competitor offerings and contributing to pricing and assortment decisions.
•	Following up on product performance, price levels, returns, obsolescence and opportunities for assortment improvements.
•	Providing technical product knowledge and supporting the sales organization in product-related matters.
•	Working with suppliers, category management, logistics and other internal stakeholders to maintain a competitive product offering.

The position combines day-to-day operational responsibilities with opportunities to participate in broader commercial and category management activities.

You will work closely with the local Head of Commercial Vehicles in Denmark and colleagues within the wider MEKO CV organization. Strategic category direction and additional support are provided by the responsible Group Category Manager.

This is an individual contributor role without personnel responsibility.


Din Profil

Your profile

We are primarily looking for someone who understands the technical and practical side of the heavy commercial vehicle industry.

You might currently be working as a Spare Parts Specialist, Parts Manager, Technical Sales Representative, Product Specialist, Workshop Coordinator or Product Manager. Your current title is less important than your experience and knowledge.

A background from truck and trailer workshops, spare parts distribution, fleet maintenance, agricultural machinery, construction equipment or other heavy-duty applications may be relevant.

We believe you bring:

•	Strong knowledge of commercial vehicles, components, spare parts and their applications.
•	Relevant experience from heavy commercial vehicles (truck, trailer, bus) or comparable heavy-duty applications – e.g. from workshop, spare parts, technical sales or product work.
•	Good computer skills and the ability to work in a structured way with product information.
•	An interest in developing analytical, commercial and product management skills.
•	Initiative, curiosity and the ability to work independently while collaborating with others.
•	Good communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken.
It is advantageous if you also have:
•	Previous experience in product management, assortment development or technical purchasing.
•	Experience with Excel, ERP or PIM systems.
•	Experience analyzing product information, sales data or market developments.
•	Danish language skills or knowledge of other Nordic languages.
•	A post-secondary technical education.

Your understanding of trucks, trailers and heavy-duty components, combined with your motivation and willingness to learn, will be central to your success.


Om företaget

About MEKO

MEKO is Northern Europe's largest player in the automotive aftermarket, with approximately 600 stores, 20,000 workshop customers and 4,600 workshops across eight countries, operating through strong brands such as Mekonomen, MECA and FTZ.

The Group drives development in digitalization, AI and logistics, offering smart and sustainable solutions for vehicle service and spare parts. MEKO's vision is to enable mobility – today, tomorrow and in the future.
In Denmark, MEKO operates through FTZ, a well-established name in the Danish automotive aftermarket. The Commercial Vehicle Division is an expanding business area with a focus on trucks, trailers and other heavy-duty applications.

As part of the team, you will work in a dynamic international environment with experienced technical and commercial colleagues, contributing to the development of a business with strong growth ambitions.

Location: The preferred base is FTZ's headquarters in Rørup, Denmark. Candidates living in Southern Sweden are also welcome to apply. The role requires regular on-site presence in Rørup, especially during the initial onboarding period. The practical setup will be discussed with the selected candidate.


Kontaktuppgifter

Contact

In this recruitment, MEKO Danmark is partnering with Autorekrytering. If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact Clemens Döring, Clemens.doring@autorekrytering.se.

We look forward to your application!
